title: Empress Of - Breaking and Entering
summary: Lorely Rodriguez, aka Empress Of, is a Latin American musician from Los Angeles. Lorely joins Breaking And Entering to chat to fill-in host Charlie Miller about the strong voices that shaped her life growing up, as well as her latest album Us. Us is a much more collaborative piece of work than her debut Me. Lorely filled the writing process with people she loves, and musicians that inspire her, creating a sense of community and ‘a way to deal with how crazy the world is’.
